description: Watercolor of a blue-gray colonial with red shutters on a lakeshore at golden hour. New cover for the Smith Mountain Lake and Lake Gaston region set.
Aerial of patchwork green farmland and tree lines, no house.
Aerial of a blue two-story farmhouse alone in an open field, wide crop.
Bright open-plan living room with neutral sofas and the kitchen beyond.
Couple walking hand in hand through a tall-grass field at sunset, seen from behind.
Family of four holding hands facing a modern farmhouse at dusk. 700px version.
Same family-at-dusk scene, 900px version for wide slots.
White board-and-batten farmhouse with metal porch roof and autumn trees. Photo counterpart to the Fredericksburg painting.
Friends around a stone fire pit at sunset with flags in the yard. Tight crop of portrait 3.
Builder inside sunlit roof trusses. Tight crop of portrait 5.
Close-up of two clasped hands over a green field.
Navy kitchen with patterned backsplash and white countertops. 900px version.
Hand holding a house-shaped keychain with new keys.
Girl running through a golden field at sunset with family behind her.
Sunrise over rolling green hills, 940px. Same scene as portrait 1; no water visible despite the name.
Couple dancing in a blue-toned living room.
Navy kitchen, same scene as island-family. 700px version.
